attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Alpine Linux, extlinux bootloader) to boot with audit=1 persistently by adding it to default_kernel_opts in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and regenerating /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux. Verified persistence across a real reboot: boot_id and uptime changed, /proc/cmdline shows audit=1, and dmesg confirms "audit: enabled (after initialization)".
